nodes.label: Generation-Equivalence Grading (D01)
nodes.rationale: Gold specs are authored in the OO python-chi generation (lease.Lease / container.Container); imperative answers earn full credit iff trap-free including platform_version=2 on create_container — matches what current docs push and what the advisor emits while keeping grading fair to both generations.

nodes.label: Hallucination Canaries (D09, T4b abstention items)
nodes.rationale: T4b items carry forbidden strings / profile-allowlist checks (e.g. a device_profiles entry outside {pi_libcamera, pi_sensehat, pi_gpio} fails specifics). Canaries are placed only where the fake string is certainly fake — punishing confident fabrication without punishing possibly-correct answers.

nodes.label: AST-Only Forbidden-Call Checks (D10)
nodes.rationale: Forbidden-call checks are AST-level (calls actually made), never text-level, and required/forbidden string checks run only inside extracted code blocks — a model saying 'do NOT use add_node_reservation' in prose must not be penalized for mentioning it.

nodes.label: Distractor Robustness via A4 (D08)
nodes.rationale: Only A4's start_edge_llm.ipynb content is gold-eligible; its KVM@TACC server notebooks stay in the grounding file deliberately as bare-metal distractor content — feeding A4 measures whether the model drifts to server.Server when edge is asked for.
